description: Line-up of the Mondschein Club (Electronic Friday) in the vaulted cellar of the Ski Hotel Mondschein in Stuben am Arlberg: every Friday in winter from 21:30 to 02:00, no reservation, usually free entry. Returns the coming nights with date, DJ, where the DJ comes from, a short introduction and special nights (New Year's Eve, Longboard Classic Closing Night). Nights without a DJ yet say so. Use it for "what is on at the club", "who plays on Friday" or nightlife questions.

language.description: Language of texts and links: de, nl, en. Default de.
